title: ChatGPT Fundamentals
description: Understand what ChatGPT is, how it works, and how to use it effectively for real tasks.
learningObjectives: Explain what ChatGPT is and how it works
Identify the types of tasks ChatGPT excels at

content.content: ChatGPT is a conversational AI system developed by OpenAI. It is built on top of large language models (GPT-4, GPT-4o) that have been fine-tuned to follow instructions and hold conversations.
GPT: Generative Pre-trained Transformer—a type of large language model architecture.
Unlike search engines that retrieve existing content, ChatGPT generates new text based on patterns learned from massive datasets.
ChatGPT excels at: drafting text, summarizing documents, explaining concepts, brainstorming ideas, translating languages, writing code, and answering questions.
Common uses: 'Summarize this article,' 'Write a professional email,' 'Explain quantum computing to a beginner,' 'Debug this Python code.'

sections.title: What ChatGPT Is NOT Good At

content.content: ChatGPT can hallucinate: it may invent facts, citations, or events that sound plausible but are false. Always verify important claims.
It also has a knowledge cutoff and does not know about events after its training date. For current information, use search-augmented tools or verify externally.
Understanding these limitations is essential. ChatGPT is a powerful assistant, not an oracle.

flashcards.back: Text generation, summarization, explanation, brainstorming, translation, coding.
When a model generates plausible-sounding but false information.

items.question: Which is a limitation of ChatGPT?
options: It cannot be used for writing
items.explanation: ChatGPT can hallucinate—generating plausible but false information.

items.question: Why is it important to verify ChatGPT's output?
items.answer: Because ChatGPT can hallucinate and has a knowledge cutoff—it may generate plausible but incorrect information.
items.explanation: Verification is essential because ChatGPT is probabilistic, not factual.

notes.summary: ChatGPT is a conversational AI based on GPT models, excellent for text tasks but prone to hallucination.
